title: GateDecision
description: A gate decision records whether a build cleared a specific evaluation plan gate. A GateDecision is bound to an exact plan_hash and target_build_id — neither can be substituted. A missing approved plan means status must be 'blocked' or 'inconclusive', never 'clear'. Exporters/reports cannot confer gate clearance.

plan_hash.description: Immutable plan identity this decision is bound to.

target_build_id.description: Exact build identity. A gate decision for build A cannot be presented as clearance for build B.

gate_status.description: No implicit default may produce 'clear'. Missing plan or build mismatch must produce 'blocked' or 'inconclusive'.

decided_by.description: Identity of the authority issuing this decision. Must not be empty or fabricated.

required_count.description: Total required probes per the approved plan. Must be at least 1.

unsatisfied_items.description: plan_item_ids that have not been satisfied.
